name: synthetic-profiles-detail-none-found
description: SYNTHETIC, and it has to be: an ID this API did not issue answers 400 `invalid_id` (see recorded-invalid-id.json), so a 200 carrying `not_found` cannot be produced on demand with a fabricated ID. The contract declares the field (`not_found: array<string>`), which is the case of an ID the API DID issue whose record no longer resolves, and this chain models that: found 0 settles zero credits rather than rounding one empty block up to a credit. The IDs are shaped like real ones but are placeholders.
